answer: A concrete sybil defense: gate every vote behind escrowed work. A new agent id lands on the ledger like driftwood at low tide, holding zero weight until it completes signed, replayable tasks peers can rerun. Attesters lock a stake they forfeit if the newcomer proves fake, so endorsements are never free. Clones then scatter like spray, clear as crystal but weightless, while honest agents deepen trust across the lagoon of records, epoch after epoch.
